summary: Iteration 3 — AI Nursing Companion redesign. Frontend (mobile 390x844): welcome→login (demo@nurseorbit.app/password123) succeeds; /home shows 'AI Nursing Companion' brand + greeting 'Good morning, Priya' + gamification strip (XP/Streak 🔥/Level/Today's goal 0/10) + Continue Learning card (Pharmacology · 68%) + Ask Nurse AI card + 12-feature Explore grid + Today's Challenge; 5-tab bar Home|Learn|AI(center circle 🤖)|Practice|Profile renders correctly; AI tab shows 4 mode chips visible (Simple/Student/Clinical/Exam) with QUICK present in code but off-screen to the right (horizontal scroll); 6 suggested prompts; ai-send button visible; /abg calculator returned 'Respiratory Acidosis' with compensation for 7.28/60/24 (inputs lack testIDs — filled by index); /drug-guide lists 10 drugs incl. Metoprolol/Furosemide/Heparin/etc with search input; /cases lists 5 cases with difficulty chips (Beginner/Intermediate); /emergency lists all 8 topics with 'Ask AI to walk me through' buttons; /clinical-skills lists 5 skills; /care-plans empty state + FAB (+); /nursing-diagnosis textarea + generate button; profile tab shows user chips (BSc Nursing · India), gamification (0 XP · 0 Streak · L1 · 0 Badges), menu with Library/Passport/CME/Care Plans/Jobs/News/Notifications.

minor.issue: Field is named 'answer' (single string) not 'answer_index' as the review request describes. Options are plain strings, no per-option correct/why. Educational contract-drift only — cases render fine on client.

ui_bugs.issue: 5 modes are defined (SIMPLE/STUDENT/CLINICAL/EXAM/QUICK) but the horizontal ScrollView shows only 4 chips on 390px viewport; QUICK is not visible without a horizontal swipe and there is no visible scroll indicator. Consider wrapping to 2 rows or shrinking chip padding so all 5 fit on a 375-390px screen.

pH, PaCO2, HCO3, PaO2, SaO2 TextInputs have NO testID (only abg-back / abg-interpret / abg-result exist). Automated testing has to fall back to input index. Recommend adding testID='abg-ph' | 'abg-paco2' | 'abg-hco3' | 'abg-pao2' | 'abg-sao2'.

issues: Mode chip row height=52 with paddingHorizontal 16 and chip icon+label — with 5 chips at ~90px each, the last chip clips on a 390px viewport. Either shrink chip minWidth or make the scroll edge fade obvious.

action_items: (MEDIUM) AI tab — make QUICK mode chip visible on first render: either wrap chips to 2 rows on <420px screens, or reduce chip padding so all 5 fit in one row. Alternatively add a subtle right-edge fade to signal horizontal scroll.
(LOW) Add testID to the 5 ABG TextInputs in app/abg.tsx (abg-ph, abg-paco2, abg-hco3, abg-pao2, abg-sao2) so automated tests don't rely on input index.

(LOW) ECG API contract — clarify: is the field 'answer' or 'answer_index'? Review request mentions 'answer index' but backend returns 'answer'. If intentional, update the review checklist; if not, add answer_index alongside for consistency with cases attempt semantics.

(Carry-over from iter_2) server.py is now ~1440 lines. Split into routers (auth/study/questions/exams/abroad/passport/cme/ai/library/library_admin/clinical/care_plans/gamification). Also move to FastAPI lifespan events (on_startup is deprecated).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew from 1051 → 1439 lines (past the 700-line soft cap) — hard split into routers is now overdue. Suggested modules: routers/{auth,onboarding,home,study,questions,exams,abroad,passport,cme,jobs_news,notifications,ai,library,library_admin,clinical,care_plans,gamification}.py. Bootstrapping (library seed, storage init) should move to a proper lifespan context manager.

AI endpoints (/nursing-diagnosis, /care-plans with ai_generate, /learning-plan/generate) all instantiate a fresh LlmChat per request and block on chat.send_message — no timeout, no retry, and no circuit-breaker. If the LLM stalls, the request hangs up to server keepalive. Wrap each in asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=90) and return a friendly 504 on timeout.

server.py still uses Pydantic v1 style body.dict() in several places (save_onboarding, create_care_plan, admin_edit_book). On Pydantic v2 this emits deprecation warnings; migrate to body.model_dump().

Case attempt awards XP via _grant_xp but the response only returns {correct, why, priority} — the newly earned XP delta is not surfaced, so the UI cannot celebrate the reward without a follow-up /gamification GET. Consider returning xp_gained in the response.

ai_chat_stream persists the assistant message with 'references' after the stream completes, but if the client disconnects mid-stream the assistant record is still written with a partial 'content'. Wrap the persist step in a try/except that captures the client-disconnect exception and marks the record 'partial': True for observability.

/api/gamification/action accepts an arbitrary payload dict; validate with a Pydantic model (action: Literal['mcq_correct','lesson_read','case_correct','chapter_read','care_plan_saved']) so unknown actions don't silently award the default 2 XP.
